start-here.title: First Animated Sprite
start-here.description: Load an animated sprite, rotate it with delta time, and pause it by pointer or keyboard.

start-here.title: Resize and DPR
start-here.description: Handle window resizes and device pixel ratio changes so the canvas stays sharp on high-DPI screens without stretching.

start-here.title: Scene-less App
start-here.description: Run an Application with no Scene at all — a single app-level system drives update and draw directly, loading and rendering a sprite without ever touching Scene.

start-here.title: Collect & Survive
start-here.description: Collect circles, avoid pointed hazards, and restart a complete small game with scoring and collisions.

start-here.title: Collect & Survive: From Scratch
start-here.description: Build the asset-free learning game from its guide: move a circle, collect green pickups, avoid red hazards, score points and restart.

scenes-assets.title: Scene Changes and Transitions
scenes-assets.description: Change between two scenes and compare fade, slide and bar-wipe transitions with owned scene state.

scenes-assets.title: Loading Progress and Retry
scenes-assets.description: Observe real loading progress, reproduce one failed asset, and retry only that failed request.

scenes-assets.title: Asset Catalogs
scenes-assets.description: Declare a typed Assets catalog, merge catalogs with compose, derive one with extend, and load them through two parallel queues with per-queue progress. N swaps the ground texture for the derived night catalog, G loads a ground texture by a computed path, M plays the streamed theme.

scenes-assets.title: Pause Menu
scenes-assets.description: Pause scene updates while a menu appears over the frozen world and an application tween fades in the blur; press Esc or click to pause and resume.

scenes-assets.title: Custom Transition
scenes-assets.description: Write your own SceneTransition: two bars close over the screen, the scene switch commits behind them, then they open again - with the commit/done ordering and the destroy-time resource release the lifecycle contract requires.

scenes-assets.title: Room Loading and Asset Ownership
scenes-assets.description: Enter and leave rooms while comparing retained shared assets and scene-owned resource disposal.

scenes-assets.title: Cached Assets Offline
scenes-assets.description: Warm an IndexedDB asset source, switch the loader to offline policy, compare a cache hit and miss, then clear and retry. Offline mode changes loader policy only; it does not disable the browser connection.

scenes-assets.title: Asset Browser
scenes-assets.description: Browse every standard demo asset by type and preview it with ExoJS: zoom and filter textures, animate spritesheet frames, pan rendered tile maps, play audio and video, and try fonts. Each preview loads into its own loader scope, and the Code button copies a snippet that reproduces the current settings.

scenes-assets.title: Transition Gallery
scenes-assets.description: Compare fade, crossfade, slide modes, a circular mask, shader dissolve and frozen-snapshot drift between two live scenes.

input-ui.title: Keyboard
input-ui.description: Read key state per-frame and on-event with the Keyboard API. WASD or the arrow keys move the square (per-frame polling), Esc recentres it (on-event); click the canvas first so it has keyboard focus. Key presses, the recentre action and held-key changes appear in the Output panel.

input-ui.title: Mouse and Pointer
input-ui.description: Track pointer position, button state, and movement delta; fire discrete click and drag events. Move the mouse, click to count taps, and drag the ship sprite.

input-ui.title: Input Actions and Rebinding
input-ui.description: Inspect raw input, deadzone and actions, then rebind with conflict, cancel and reset handling.

input-ui.title: Controller Inspector
input-ui.description: Connect a controller to inspect live stick and button values; see a clear waiting state while disconnected. Axes and buttons update live.

input-ui.title: Key Rebinding
input-ui.description: Rebind the jump key at runtime: press J, then any key to assign it to jump (Space by default), and the choice is saved in localStorage as a stable input token and restored on reload.

input-ui.title: Multitouch
input-ui.description: Track up to ten simultaneous touch points and render each finger as a labelled circle. Use a touchscreen with several fingers; a mouse provides a single point while a button is held.

input-ui.title: HUD and Widgets
input-ui.description: Build a screen-fixed HUD on scene.ui: anchored score and health widgets, plus a panel of clickable, keyboard-focusable buttons that update them.

input-ui.title: UI Controls and Focus
input-ui.description: Change native engine UI controls and follow pointer, Tab, Shift+Tab and keyboard focus.

input-ui.title: Text Entry and Scrolling
input-ui.description: Edit text and add rows to a scroll area while observing focus and input consumption.

input-ui.title: Dialogue and Choices
input-ui.description: Advance dialogue and choose distinct branches without duplicate queued actions.

input-ui.title: Local Split Screen
input-ui.description: Control two players in separate views and inspect independent camera following and viewport boundaries.

sprites-cameras.title: Sprite Basics
sprites-cameras.description: Load a texture, create a Sprite, and animate its position, rotation, scale and alpha inside a Scene.

sprites-cameras.title: Parent and World Transforms
sprites-cameras.description: Compare parent, local and world transforms in a sun, planet and moon hierarchy.

sprites-cameras.title: Pivot and Anchor
sprites-cameras.description: Compare three pivot and anchor origins on the same asymmetric sprite.

sprites-cameras.title: Blend Modes
sprites-cameras.description: Click the canvas, press Left/Right or use the panel to step through all 18 blend modes applied to two overlapping tinted keys; the source alpha slider and motion toggle show how each mode composites.

sprites-cameras.title: Masks
sprites-cameras.description: Clip the same image with a Rectangle mask and a Graphics circle mask; drag either mask, or bypass both to compare against the full image.

sprites-cameras.title: Texture Sampling and Pixel Snapping
sprites-cameras.description: Compare nearest, linear and mipmapped sampling side by side on a magnified top row and a minified bottom row. The wheel zooms the camera fractionally, the sliders set magnify and minify, P cycles render-only pixel snapping (none, position, geometry) and Space pauses the motion; only the sampler differs between columns.

sprites-cameras.title: Camera Navigation and Coordinates
sprites-cameras.description: Pan and zoom a camera while comparing pointer positions in screen and world coordinates.

sprites-cameras.title: Parallax Layers
sprites-cameras.description: Compare three parallax layer speeds under the same camera motion.

sprites-cameras.title: Picture in Picture
sprites-cameras.description: Embed a secondary scene view inside the main view — classic minimap or security-camera picture-in-picture layout.

sprites-cameras.title: Minimap
sprites-cameras.description: Navigate a world while comparing its main view and clickable minimap.

animation-game-feel.title: Sprite Animation
animation-game-feel.description: Compare the same eight-frame clip at fixed and adjustable frame rates with pause, shared step and reset.

animation-game-feel.title: Tweens and Easing
animation-game-feel.description: Compare easing curves and raw time, replace an active tween, and follow a sequence of route segments.

animation-game-feel.title: Tween Sequences
animation-game-feel.description: Build a looping route from an array of waypoints by chaining Tweens once and restarting the first step after the last completes. The status shows the current leg.

animation-game-feel.title: Easing Explorer
animation-game-feel.description: Select any built-in easing function with Left/Right or the panel buttons and watch a Sprite trace its large curve; overshoot stays visible above and below the 0-1 range.

animation-game-feel.title: Impact Feedback
animation-game-feel.description: Trigger an impact and compare particle, tint and camera-shake feedback.

animation-game-feel.title: Fly a Spaceship
animation-game-feel.description: Fly with keyboard or an optional controller and compare raw stick, deadzone, actions and opt-in haptics.

animation-game-feel.title: Boss Intro Cinematic
animation-game-feel.description: A tween-driven boss reveal: letterbox bars, a camera push-in, a typewriter title punched with a screen shake and a music swell. Press R or click to replay once it has played out.

graphics-text.title: Shapes and Gradients
graphics-text.description: Inspect six drawn shapes and drag the endpoints of a gradient.

graphics-text.title: Text Layout
graphics-text.description: Compare wrapping, fonts, independent heading effects and a real missing-font fallback.

graphics-text.title: Multiline and Wrap
graphics-text.description: Configure word-wrap width, line height, and horizontal alignment for multi-line Text drawables.

graphics-text.title: Bitmap Text
graphics-text.description: Compare bitmap glyphs and rasterized text at integer and fractional scales and distinguish missing fonts from missing glyphs.

graphics-text.title: Mesh Vertices and UVs
graphics-text.description: Compare vertex colors on a custom triangle with UV-mapped texture coordinates on a rotating quad.

graphics-text.title: Mesh Deformed Grid
graphics-text.description: Animate vertex positions on a Mesh grid to produce wave and ripple deformation effects.

graphics-text.title: Mesh Typed Uniforms
graphics-text.description: Declare a mesh material's uniforms once - a nested struct and a mat3 - and let the engine generate the matching GLSL block and WGSL struct for both backends.

effects-rendering.title: Bloom Threshold
effects-rendering.description: Discs get brighter from left to right and a white bar sweeps below them; Threshold sets the luminance that starts to glow, Intensity how much is added back and Spread how far it reaches; Bypass compares against the unfiltered input.

effects-rendering.title: Sprite Filters
effects-rendering.description: Compare an original sprite with Blur, Drop Shadow, Grayscale or Sepia and inspect bypass.

effects-rendering.title: Color Transforms
effects-rendering.description: The same colour ramp and painted background through a grayscale matrix, a sepia matrix, per-channel 1D curves and a 3D LUT grade, side by side with the original.

effects-rendering.title: Retro Display
effects-rendering.description: Compare scanlines, grain and RGB separation with the original image.

effects-rendering.title: Write a Fragment Filter
effects-rendering.description: Move the pointer over a UV grid to place a ripple while one typed uniform schema feeds matching GLSL and WGSL filter shaders for time and pointer position.

effects-rendering.title: Metaballs and Filter Order
effects-rendering.description: Drag the ringed blob into the moving circles, then pick blur-then-threshold, threshold-then-blur, or no filters and adjust blur strength to see how filter order changes the result.

effects-rendering.title: Capture a Texture
effects-rendering.description: Compare a live render texture of moving sprites with a frozen snapshot; click anywhere or press Space to capture a new frame into the right-hand texture.

effects-rendering.title: Trail Feedback
effects-rendering.description: Create motion trails by feeding the previous frame back into the current frame with a slight fade.

effects-rendering.title: Colour Pipeline
effects-rendering.description: Compare colour and data textures, linear-light blending, alpha edges, raw and display readback, and an optional HDR value mapped to SDR; press Space or tap to switch the HDR panel between clamp and Reinhard.

effects-rendering.title: Water Reflection and Distortion
effects-rendering.description: Capture and flip a live reflection, then drag horizontally across the water to change the strength of its scrolling displacement map (left is calm, right is strong).

effects-rendering.title: Play a Video Texture
effects-rendering.description: Play, pause and seek an existing video after an explicit gesture and inspect load, media and teardown states.

effects-rendering.title: Composable Render Pipeline
effects-rendering.description: Compose named offscreen, blur, custom callback, and screen-space HUD passes; click or press Space to toggle the blur pass and compare the live bypass.

effects-rendering.title: Custom Triangle Renderer
effects-rendering.description: Write raw WGSL and wire a custom WebGPU pipeline alongside the built-in renderer — a minimal custom-renderer skeleton.

lighting.title: Normal-Mapped Lighting
lighting.description: Drag the large light marker across a normal-mapped floor, then vary the active light count from 1 to 48 with the slider and watch the draw-call readout stay flat; Resume first orbit releases the dragged light.

lighting.title: Cast Shadows from Shapes
lighting.description: Move a Point or Spot light around shapes, adjust shadow softness and inspect occluders.

lighting.title: Light Cookies
lighting.description: Four light shapes and two textures doing the work of geometry: window bars and leaf shade are cookies carried by the lights themselves (their bars drift with the lamp), a neon tube pools in a capsule, and a sun with no position throws parallel shadows. Use the time-of-day and sun sliders, and toggle cookies on and off.

lighting.title: Light a Normal-Mapped Surface
lighting.description: Two lights follow the pointer over one cobbled floor: the left half has normals derived from each stone's alpha, the right half has none, so the relief and its slightly darker read show side by side. Light height and a normal-buffer view are in the panel.

lighting.title: Radiance Rooms
lighting.description: One lamp, one doorway: switch between the radiance renderer (transported light with an optional bounce) and the lightmap renderer (drawn light). Space pauses the lamp so both can be compared at the same position; Lamp and Softness tune the source.

particles.title: Control a Particle Emitter
particles.description: Drag a particle emitter and adjust rate, lifetime and speed with simulation pause and reset.

particles.title: Attract and Repel Particles
particles.description: Attract or repel a particle cloud and compare falloff, radius and pointer or keyboard placement.

particles.title: Fireworks
particles.description: Click anywhere to launch a firework rocket from the bottom at that x position; it bursts into flash, spark and ember layers at its apex, and rockets also launch on their own.

particles.title: Campfire
particles.description: Adjust flame intensity and wind with the sliders while fire and smoke rise from a visible ring of logs and stones.

particles.title: Audio Reactive Particles
particles.description: Particles driven by the music: low-band energy sets how many spawn and high-band energy how wide they spread, so silence stays still; detected beats recolour the stream.

particles.title: Particle Capacity
particles.description: Adjust the spawn rate and watch live occupancy, frame time, and whether particles run on WebGPU compute or the smaller WebGL2 fallback.

particles.title: Custom Wgsl Module
particles.description: SwayModule supplies apply(), glsl() and wgsl() with shared uniforms, so the same custom particle behaviour runs on the CPU, in WebGL2 transform feedback or as a WebGPU compute pass; the status shows which path runs.

audio.title: Play a Sound
audio.description: Click a pad or press 1-4 to play a labeled UI or impact sound through its own bus, with a volume slider, mute and a live waveform of the bus output.

audio.title: Polyphonic Sound
audio.description: Hold Space, a mouse button or a finger to fire heavy impacts faster than they finish: the pool caps concurrent voices, each shot varies its pitch, and at capacity the oldest voice is evicted.

audio.title: Music Playback and Crossfade
audio.description: Play two contrasting music streams, then drag the A/B crossfade to hear their gain balance. Space pauses both tracks.

audio.title: Mix Music and Effects
audio.description: Mix looping music with three distinct effects. Adjust Master, Music and Effects independently; press 1-3 or use the sound buttons.

audio.title: Crossfade Tracks
audio.description: Choose Track A or Track B in the panel and watch each gain meter follow the scheduled two-second voice crossfade between the two looping tracks.

audio.title: Hear an Audio Effect
audio.description: Compare Dry, Small room, Hall and Echo on an existing impact or speech source and stop remaining effect tails.

audio.title: Streaming PCM
audio.description: Feed stereo PCM through the music bus and inspect the bounded queue; stop the producer to hear starvation, then clear the queue, drain it or start a new stream. Playback starts on the first click or key press.

audio.title: GPU Stereo PCM
audio.description: Generate stereo samples on the GPU, read bounded blocks back as packed bytes or floats chosen in the panel, and stream them through the music bus. Playback starts on the first click or key press; changing the format creates a fresh stream.

audio.title: Compression
audio.description: A quiet music loop feeds a CompressorEffect; switch to the loud input to push the peaks over the threshold and watch the live gain-reduction meter. Threshold, ratio and bypass are in the panel.

audio.title: Duck Music under Speech
audio.description: Start the music bed, then play speech and watch the music meter duck while the voice meter spikes: the DuckingEffect lowers the music bus whenever its sidechain voice bus is loud. Toggle Ducking to compare.

audio.title: Convolution Rooms
audio.description: Strike four impact materials, each panned to its position, inside 30 measured rooms from a 1 ms tail to a cavern; step through the rooms with Left/Right or the panel.

audio.title: Audio Effect Rack
audio.description: Pick one of four distinct effect chains, read its order on the rack and the spectrum, play an impact, and toggle bypass to compare it against the level-matched dry output.

audio.title: Audio Signal Graph
audio.description: See the real routing from sources through bus effects to the master output: every box is a real source, effect or bus, every wire a real connection. Click a node to edit its parameters or bypass it and watch each bus level.

audio.title: Vocoder
audio.description: Pick a spoken phrase and play it, then switch Processed off to compare the dry voice with the robot voice made by modulating a sustained saw carrier. Audio starts on the first click or key press.

audio.title: Read Spectrum and Waveform
audio.description: Read actual spectrum and waveform data from coded Pulse or Noise signals; the approved M3 source remains unavailable.

audio.title: Beat and Tempo
audio.description: A BeatDetector on the music bus pulses the ship and bursts particles on every detected beat while the tempo estimate and its confidence update continuously.

audio.title: Position a Sound Source
audio.description: Move a mono sound around a fixed listener and compare three distance falloff models.

worlds-navigation.title: Tilemap Projections
worlds-navigation.description: Compare isometric and hex picking while retaining the isometric physics bridge.

worlds-navigation.title: Hexagonal & Staggered Grids
worlds-navigation.description: Lay out hexagonal and staggered tile maps the way Tiled does, pick the cell under the pointer, and switch layouts with the Grid panel. Every tile is its own canvas texture in an image-collection TileSet, and trees overhang the row above.

worlds-navigation.title: Layered Tile World
worlds-navigation.description: Navigate a layered tile world and compare canopy, pixel snapping and fractional zoom.

worlds-navigation.title: Load a Tiled Map
worlds-navigation.description: Load and render a .tmj room with the common tileMap asset type, then click highlighted objects to inspect their editor-authored names, types, and properties.

worlds-navigation.title: LDtk World Import
worlds-navigation.description: Load a multi-level LDtk world, switch between its runtime TileMap levels and toggle the IntGrid overlay in the LDtk panel. Coloured squares come from getLdtkIntGridValueAt(), which resolves the raw Walls cells to their LDtk-authored name and colour, and entity fields are read from the converted ObjectLayer.

worlds-navigation.title: Editor Maps and Gameplay
worlds-navigation.description: Turn authored map objects into an interactive keyboard or pointer puzzle.

worlds-navigation.title: Pathfinding Playground
worlds-navigation.description: Compare weighted navigation, JPS, smoothing, agent footprint and diagonal rules on editable scenarios.

worlds-navigation.title: Editable Map Navigation
worlds-navigation.description: Move the white player with WASD or the arrow keys while orange navigation agents hunt you around the walls, and click a tile to open or close it to watch every route adapt. Hunters re-route when you change tile or edit the map; the blue patroller follows a hand-placed waypoint graph.

worlds-navigation.title: Paint an Autotiled Room
worlds-navigation.description: Paint and erase an autotiled room against a complete sixteen-mask reference.

worlds-navigation.title: Streaming Tile Worlds
worlds-navigation.description: Explore a streamed world and inspect resident chunk boundaries and ownership.

worlds-navigation.title: Streamed Terrain
worlds-navigation.description: Fly across a deterministic unbounded world with WASD and compare synchronous and worker-backed terrain sampling: pick the provider and sample cost, or roll a new seed, in the Provider panel. Raise the cost, then switch to worker to compare frame time while moving; the spinning character is a jank indicator.

physics-collision.title: Rectangles Collision
physics-collision.description: Drag either rectangle over the other and detect AABB overlap in the update loop: both tint red and the overlap region lights up while the status shows its size. Foundational collision recipe.

physics-collision.title: Drag and Throw Physics
physics-collision.description: Drag and throw three physical bodies with rotated hit testing and reset.

physics-collision.title: Kinematic Movement
physics-collision.description: Steer a kinematic body with WASD or the arrow keys; it stops at walls, slides along them when you push in at an angle, and comes to rest in tight corners. The status shows blocked or free with the surface normal.

physics-collision.title: Character Movement
physics-collision.description: Traverse ramps, steps, one-way platforms and moving shuttles with keyboard or optional gamepad actions.

physics-collision.title: Tiled Collision Map
physics-collision.description: Load an authored .tmj room, build static bodies from its Collision object layer with buildObjectLayerColliders(), and toggle the authored collision outlines while a dynamic actor lands on them.

physics-collision.title: Joint-Driven Shadows
physics-collision.description: Drag the hinged physics arm through a live light and watch its collider reshape the shadow it casts. PhysicsOccluder includes dynamic bodies here; its static-only default would omit the moving arm.

physics-collision.title: Material Lab
physics-collision.description: Drop wood, metal and stone balls together, compare bounce and sliding friction, then reset the same starting state.

performance-diagnostics.title: Interaction Inspector
performance-diagnostics.description: Drag overlapping sprites and press 1, 2 or 3 to bring that sprite to the front while the debug overlays show pointer targets, hit tests, and scene-graph bounds. The Output panel names the sprite each tap hit and where each drag ended.

performance-diagnostics.title: Sprite Batching Laboratory
performance-diagnostics.description: One seeded sprite workload with the performance overlay: change the sprite count (Up/Down), share one texture or spread over four (T) and switch between WebGL2 and WebGPU when available (B), or use the panel.

performance-diagnostics.title: Retained Container
performance-diagnostics.description: A static field of sprites drifts as one group like a camera pan. With the retained tier on, the field replays as recorded batches with one group-matrix update; off, a plain Container walks every child each frame. The panel shows submitted nodes and frame time.

performance-diagnostics.title: Immediate-Mode Rendering
performance-diagnostics.description: Draw procedural geometry without a scene graph: gears via drawGeometry and a 2,400-spark field as one instanced RenderBatch. Turn batching off to draw each spark separately and watch the draw-call count.

performance-diagnostics.title: Coroutine Loading
performance-diagnostics.description: Spread world building over frames with a coroutine: a progress-driven loading bar, a share-based frame budget, and cancellation.
